title: Time Budget Mechanism Across Composable Skills
summary: Each skill in the Composable Skill Family prompts for available time during or immediately after Context Gathering and adapts along a continuous spectrum with three guideposts — Deep (30+ minutes), Standard (10-30 minutes), Focused (under 10 minutes) — scaling work decomposition breadth, refactor depth, and stewardship frequency accordingly. User validation of orientation is never skipped regardless of budget, and the time budget is advisory only: the skill does not watch a clock and adapts mid-session if the developer wants to go deeper.
workflow_point: each Composable Skill Family skill, during or immediately after Context Gathering
mechanism: advisory time-budget prompt calibrating scope along a Deep/Standard/Focused spectrum

links.note: Extends the review skill's existing time-prompt mechanism (ADR-044 interaction specifications) to all four skills in the Composable Skill Family.
